name: Insurance-led small-carrier compliance hub (Chicago 8 counties)
summary: Done-for-you DOT compliance + D&A consortium subscription sold to established 3-20 PU for-hire carriers; ~25% of clients also place trucking insurance through an aggregator/wholesaler (commission netted of split) - insurance commission is folded into blended ARPC.
evidence_notes: Buyer universe A: 3,166 for-hire carriers with 3-20 PU registered before 2021 in 8 Chicago counties, median 6 PU (DC-S001).
Churn derived from census cohorts: exit of 5-10-yr-old carriers ~6-7%/yr, 3-5 yr ~15%/yr (A data, E arithmetic, DC-S002); agency/vendor switching added as E.
Compliance price D: $149-$249/mo done-for-you plans incl. consortium, $99 setup (C4-S011); $150-400 (C4-S012). Consortium $149/yr (C, C4-S006). DQ software $5/driver/mo (B, C4-S008).

Insurance: ~10% commission via MGAs/wholesalers (D, DC-S014) inside a 15.9% Illinois selling-expense pool (C, C4-S015); premium/PU $12k base anchored on ATRI 10.6 c/mile (C, WS02-S017); aggregator split 20% and attach rate 25% are E.
Licensing A: 40 h pre-licensing, $184 exams, $215 producer + $250 entity licence, broker bond $2,500+ (DC-S005..S007).
ARPC base = $250 compliance + $12.5 consortium + $25 filings + 0.25 x (6 PU x $12k x 10% x 0.8)/12 = $407.5 -> $405.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDOI 20 h/line pre-licensing + exams + 5-day wait + NIPR (DC-S005); aggregator onboarding 24-48 h claimed (DC-S009, DC-S010) but trucking market access unconfirmed
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Insurance shopped 30-60 days pre-renewal; compliance 1-6 weeks (Stage A/C, E)
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations from mail/web/yard visits to a 3,166-carrier universe (DC-S001); hours-based estimate
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free DQ/CSA audit converts conversation to proposal; no benchmark found
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Assumed; competitors OOIDA/Simplex/agency freebies (C4-S004, C4-S013, C4-S038) cap win rate
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Census cohort survival (DC-S002): 6-15%/yr carrier exit for 3-10-yr-old carriers + vendor switching (E)
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Compliance $200/250/300 (C4-S011, C4-S012) + consortium (C4-S006) + filings (E) + attach 15/25/35% x commission on 6-7 PU x $10-14k premium x 9-12% x 75-85% retained (DC-S014, C4-S015, WS02-S017)
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: $99 enrolment fee observed (C4-S011); file rebuild priced higher in base/opt (E)
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs ~$56/mo on $405: DQ software 8 drivers x $5 (C4-S008), MVR $12.95/driver/yr, consortium cost ~50% of fee (E); coordinator labor carried in staff
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: MVR/PSP pulls at onboarding consume most of the setup fee
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card/ACH ~1.5% + commission chargebacks/bad debt 2-3.5% (cancellation for non-pay common in trucking)
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Audit time/MVR samples, travel to yards
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Direct mail to ~3,166 carriers x 3-4 touches/yr at ~$0.80 + web
drivers.dso_days__source: Compliance billed monthly in advance by ACH; commissions arrive ~30-45 days after premium collection
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Sub-$1M-EBITDA agencies trade far below large-deal multiples (WS02-S007); 3x kept

staff.notes: BLS Chicago claims/policy clerk median $51,280 x1.25 load (C, C4-S016)
